verdict.rationale: Logseq's docs confirm a new Journals page is created automatically each day at midnight (the equivalent of Roam's Daily Notes) and that the app always opens on the Journals page, which covers the automatic daily note and default landing place. Nothing in the evidence shows journal pages being pre-filled from a template, a stated part of the story. Missing for 10: evidence of template-based pre-filling of daily journal pages, independent or hands-on corroboration of the daily-journal workflow.
